rule_freeze.macro_turning_rule: unchanged from PR #172: relative second-difference inflation plus sign-inverted unemployment; both components must agree; no magnitude threshold
rule_freeze.fx_entry: first official ECB common fixing strictly after the rates-confirmation monthly as-of
rule_freeze.fx_exit: first official ECB common fixing strictly after the following monthly day-10 anchor

partial_results_policy: Any sample below the full gate remains WAITING regardless of interim performance.
promotion_policy: Even a forward PASS creates VALIDATED_PENDING_PROMOTION only; production/sizing require separate explicit promotion review.
